clauses.clause: Riot infected: frontal MG hits visibly chip HP + recoil at every range incl. point blank; frontal MG kill ≤ 6 s (measured 3.7 s), flank ≤ 2 s; health bar always shown; one riot cop alone does not down a full-HP player that keeps firing (tune). PO: "I feel I have zero effect when I shoot them."
clauses.note: Live one-riot mortal MG duels at both tiers:0.9/1.6/3/6/20/26m, no AI disable or god protection. Courier survives every duel (point blank89HP, all others100HP). Front shots chip2.52HP at normal frontal ranges. At20m actual first damage→incapacitation is9.40s (fight9.93s), at26m12.70s (fight13.97s), exceeding the unchanged frontal≤6s criterion; the original6m isolated3.7s result remains valid for that narrower case. The counterexample closes FAIL across tested ranges; visible chips/recoil, always-shown bars, flank and perceived effectiveness remain separate. P: PO: does firing at a riot infected feel effective? Review the perceived hit feedback only; HP chips, recoil, TTK, bars and the full-health duel retain objective checks.
